meta.description: Claude Code configuration snapshot for cross-platform synchronization. Target consumers should evaluate OS-specific implementations and propose adaptations.

osSpecific.intent: Send OS-native toast notification on session stop

scripts.content:
# Windows 11 Toast Notification for Claude Code
param(
    [string]$Title = "Claude Code",
    [string]$Message = "任务已完成",
    [string]$Icon = "Info"
)

# Load Windows Runtime assemblies for Toast notifications
[Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastNotificationManager, Windows.UI.Notifications, ContentType = WindowsRuntime] | Out-Null
[Windows.Data.Xml.Dom.XmlDocument, Windows.Data.Xml.Dom.XmlDocument, ContentType = WindowsRuntime] | Out-Null

# Define the toast template XML
$ToastXml = @"
<toast>
    <visual>
        <binding template="ToastGeneric">
            <text>$Title</text>
            <text>$Message</text>
        </binding>
    </visual>
    <audio src="ms-winsoundevent:Notification.Default" />
</toast>
"@

# Create XML document
$XmlDocument = [Windows.Data.Xml.Dom.XmlDocument]::new()
$XmlDocument.LoadXml($ToastXml)

# Create the toast notification
$Toast = [Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastNotification]::new($XmlDocument)

# Show the notification using PowerShell as the app ID
$AppId = '{1AC14E77-02E7-4E5D-B744-2EB1AE5198B7}\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe'
[Windows.UI.Notifications.ToastNotificationManager]::CreateToastNotifier($AppId).Show($Toast)

Write-Host "✓ Windows notification sent: $Title - $Message"

macOSEquivalent.scriptTemplate: display notification "会话结束\n时间: " & (current date) with title "Claude Code - 任务完成" sound name "default"

linuxEquivalent.command: notify-send 'Claude Code - 任务完成' '会话结束'
